name: Better For You Wellness, Inc.
summary: Better For You Wellness, Inc. presently conducts no substantial operational activities. Its primary objective is to thoroughly investigate and assess prospective business ventures across the expanding plant-based food, beverage, and consumer packaged goods (CPG) industries. This enterprise, founded in 2020 and maintaining its headquarters in Columbus, Ohio, operated under the name Fast Track Solutions, Inc. until its rebranding to Better For You Wellness, Inc. in August 2021. The company functions as a subsidiary of Green Ohio Ventures, LLC.
